lede: Wat Ratanaram accounts for 11 catalogued manuscripts. It clusters in Chiang Mai (100% of the corpus for this temple). Nearly all (100%) are written in Tham Lanna · อักษรธรรมล้านนา script. Dated witnesses run 1840–1871 CE (9 of 11 carry a date).
